instruction: Access the URL from the latest Bills email and display it in Chrome while closing the existing Apple and Google Scholar tabs.

metadata.explanation: Task requires opening the Amazon link from Bills email and closing all other tabs. The evaluator checks that exactly 1 tab remains: Amazon. Uses existing functions.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator checks all instruction requirements - opening Amazon URL and closing both Apple and Google Scholar tabs
Getter 'get_open_tabs_info' correctly extracts current open tabs state (returns list of dicts with 'url' and 'title' for each tab)
Metric 'is_expected_tabs' uses exact list matching via 'are_lists_equal' which verifies both tab count (exactly 1) and tab URL (Amazon)
Expected value correctly specifies single Amazon URL ['https://www.amazon.com/'], which implicitly verifies other tabs were closed
Logical correctness: By checking that ONLY Amazon tab exists (exact list equality), the evaluator ensures Apple and Google Scholar tabs are NOT present
Data flow is correct: getter extracts tabs → metric compares with expected → returns 1.0 only if exactly 1 tab with Amazon URL exists
Postconfig includes sleep 1s which allows tab state to settle after actions
